edition_angle: Focusing on cross-species conserved mechanisms of synaptic plasticity to distinguish physiological healthy brain aging from pathological neurodegeneration.

assignments.angle: Cross-species transcriptomics reveals efferocytosis and conserved genetic targets regulating synaptic plasticity during physiological healthy brain aging.
assignments.reason: This study offers concrete genetic and bioinformatic pathway analysis distinguishing healthy aging from pathological decay, aligning well with the Luminous Mind spiral while filling a critical analytical gap in cross-species conserved synaptic mechanisms.
